pattern: keep groups whose derived change is negative, null rounds drop out
question: women 15-49 literacy decreased between the two rounds - name those districts
gold_sql: SELECT "District" FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: WITH round1 AS (SELECT "District", "State", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS lit1 FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'), round2 AS (SELECT "District", "State", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS lit2 FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5') SELECT r1."District" FROM round1 AS r1 JOIN round2 AS r2 ON r1."District" = r2."District" WHERE NOT r1."lit1" IS NULL AND NOT r2."lit2" IS NULL AND r2."lit2" < r1."lit1"

WITH round1 AS (
  SELECT "District", "State", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS lit1
  FROM "district_health_factsheet"
  WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
),
round2 AS (
  SELECT "District", "State", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS lit2
  FROM "district_health_factsheet"
  WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
)
SELECT r1."District"
FROM round1 r1
JOIN round2 r2 ON r1."District" = r2."District"
WHERE r1."lit1" IS NOT NULL
  AND r2."lit2" IS NOT NULL
  AND r2."lit2" < r1."lit1";
